description: Blog or news of the store that the CMS search must not return: activation date in the future (state futureActivation) or expiration date passed (state expired); no searchable blog/news title contains its code (the term the test searches). Outputs: blogNewsCode, seoTitle. Read only.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

state.description: Why it is not searchable: futureActivation (ActivationDate after now) or expired (ExpirationDate before now)
